messages.content: Help me sort a list of items  myItemList alphabetically and ascendingly, but place items with a status of 'urgent' at the top, assuming the list is an array of objects with 'name' and 'status' properties?

function.name: prioritizeAndSort
function.description: This function sorts an array of objects based on their 'name' property, while prioritizing items based on a specified status. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

items.description: The array of objects to be sorted. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

priorityStatus.description: The status value that should be given priority in the sorting. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

ascending.description: A flag indicating whether the sorting should be in ascending (true) or descending (false) order, excluding priority items. This is JavaScript Boolean type parameter in string representation.

We can pass something like "[{ name:'a', status:'normal'}, ...]" But maybe just placeholder "myItemList". According to description: items: string - The array of objects to be sorted.
